Avulsion (river).question: What is Avulsion (river)? Rapid abandonment of a river channel and formation of a new channel.
Avulsion (river).fact: In sedimentary geology and fluvial geomorphology, avulsion is the process by which flow is diverted out of an set up river channel and into a new course via a bifurcation, or splitting of the channel.
